title: [clinic · EX-21] Cost model for a real client shape
body:
> **Exercise clinic.** One long-running thread per exercise. Ask here rather than opening a
> new thread — the answers accumulate where the next person will look for them.
>
> **Exercise:** [`EX-21` — Cost model for a real client shape](https://github.com/akash-coded/nanorag/blob/main/docs/30-learning/exercises/ex-21-cost-model-for-a-real-client-shape.md) · difficulty 🟡

## What this exercise asks

Read the exercise first; this thread is for when you are stuck, not instead of it.

## Three ways people get stuck on this one

**1.** Modelling per-query cost only. The cluster, the initial backfill and the re-embed cycle are the majority — [#44](https://github.com/akash-coded/nanorag/issues/44).

**2.** Assuming the corpus is static. The change rate drives the re-embed bill and is the input people never ask for.

**3.** One point estimate with no sensitivity. The useful output is which input moves the total most.

## How to ask here

Post the **numbers you got**, the **config that produced them**, and **what you already tried**.
A question with a measurement in it gets answered in one round trip; a question without one
takes three.

If you have finished it, post the write-up in **Show and Tell** with the
`[solution · EX-21]` prefix rather than here — this thread stays for people who are stuck.
